sentences.text:
Petitioner :- Mohd. Aslam
Respondent :- State Of U.P.Thru Prin.Secy. Urban Development Deptt. & Ors.

Counsel for Petitioner :- Amjad Siddiqui,Abdul Shadab Khan Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Jageshwari Prasad Mathur Hon'ble Alok Singh,J.
Hon'ble Karunesh Singh Pawar,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Additional CSC for respondent no. 1 and

Shri J. P.
Mathur, learned counsel for respondent no. 3.

Petitioner has filed an application for grant of license, vide annexure no. 2, under the provisions of the Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006 and the regulations made thereunder but till date his application has not been decided by the authority concerned and, therefore, prayer has been made to decide the same expeditiously.

Learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel, has submitted that if the application of the petitioner is still pending then the same will be decided in the light of the order of this Court dated 12.5.2017 passed in Writ Petition (M/B) No. 8293 of 2017.

Considering the aforesaid, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the competent authority respondent no. 4 is directed to consider and decide the application of the petitioner for registration of license, as the case may be, in accordance with law, in the light of the order dated Mohd. Aslam vs State Of U.P.Thru Prin.Secy. Urban ... on 17 December, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/19429514/
1 12.5.2017 passed by this Court in Writ Petition (M/B) No. 8293 of 2017, within a period of two months from the date of production of certified copy of this order before him by a reasoned and speaking order.
With the aforesaid, writ petition is disposed of.
Order Date :- 17.12.2020 J.K. Dinkar  Mohd. Aslam vs State Of U.P.Thru Prin.Secy. Urban ... on 17 December, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/19429514/
